summary: {attendant} looks up a drop-in swimmer's discount when the swimmer has no printed pass.
realLife: Portland instructed drop-in users to mention their discount so staff could retrieve it or print a pass.
gates: The local government runs the recreation service and is considering or implementing a change to its fee.
inGame: The park fee series supplies the jurisdiction's change in the charge level. needs: an active discount, a drop-in admission and a matching participant record.

turns.pulledBy: At the higher walk-in price the swimmer asks staff to find the account.
turns.what: The attendant applies the verified discount.
turns.writesBack: The admission receipt shows the reduced amount.

turns.pulledBy: The lower walk-in price is posted while the swimmer's discount remains active.
turns.what: Staff look up the discount against the new rate.
turns.writesBack: The till records the amount actually paid.
